description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of various models on different morphosyntactic categories, comparing the performance of XLM-L2, XLM-R2, XLM-B2, mBERT-R2, and mBERT-B2 across case, gender, number, and tense. The horizontal axis represents the categories, listed in the order of case, gender, number, and tense, while the vertical axis is labeled "effect" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, marked at intervals of 5. For each category, a group of five bars represents the different models, colored according to the legend: XLM-L2 (light blue), XLM-R2 (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (dark green), mBERT-B2 (pink), and XLM-B2 (red). The bars for the "case" category have approximate values of 6 for XLM-L2 and XLM-R2, 3 for mBERT-R2 and XLM-R2, and 12 and 11 for mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2, respectively. The "gender" category shows values around 2 for XLM-L2 and XLM-R2, 3 for mBERT-R2, 2 for XLM-R2, and 5 and 4 for mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2. The "number" category has values of approximately 3 for XLM-L2, 2 for XLM-R2, 2 for mBERT-R2, 1 for XLM-R2, and 4 and 3 for mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2. The "tense" category displays values close to 1 across all models. The chart also includes error bars for each data point, indicating the range of variation. The bars are grouped by category, with each group representing the different models, and are not sorted in a specific order within the groups.
